message.map_atlases.shear.info: Click on a map to remove it
map_atlases.configuration.general.max_ma: The maximum number of Maps (Filled & Empty combined) allowed to be inside an Atlas.
map_atlases.configuration.general.accept: If enabled, you can increase the Empty Map count by inserting Paper
map_atlases.configuration.general.requir: If true, the Atlas is required to have spare Empty Maps stored to expand the Filled Map size
map_atlases.configuration.general.pity_a: Controls how many free Empty Maps you get for 'activating' an Inactive Atlas
map_atlases.configuration.general.enable: Enable Empty Map Entry And Fill
If 'true', Atlases will be able to store Empty Maps and auto-fill them as you explore.
map_atlases.configuration.general.activa: Locations of where an atlas will be scanned for. By default only hotbar will be scanned
map_atlases.configuration.general.creati: Allows players in creative to teleport using the atlas. Hold shift and press anywhere
map_atlases.configuration.general.pin_ma: Marker id associated with the red pin button on the atlas screen. Set to empty string to disable
map_atlases.configuration.general.mob_ra: Show nearby mobs on minimap. Needs matching client config also set
map_atlases.configuration.update_logic.u: Update maps in simple round robin fashion instead of prioritizing the ones closer
map_atlases.configuration.update_logic.m: Max of maps to update each tick. Increase to make maps update faster
Range multiplier of the map update. Logic affects all maps, atlas or not. Change to make the range smaller or bigger
Makes map update on different threads, speeding up the process. Disable if it causes issues. Especially on servers. Try turning on for a big performance improvement regarding map atlas update
Every how many ticks should markers be updated
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.enable: If 'true', the Mini-Map of the Active Map will be drawn on the HUD while the Atlas is active.
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.hide_w: Hides minimap when inventory is open
Hide When Debug Screen Is Open
Hides minimap when the F3 debug screen is open
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.shows_: Shows a background texture for each map, useful to see where each map ends
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.hide_w: Hide minimap when holding the atlas in hand
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.only_s: Only Show Y When Has Slices
Only display y coordinates if atlas holds some slice maps
Global scale of entire minimap HUD. Keep at 1 for pixel perfect consistency
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.zoom_m: How many maps to display in a single minimap. Essentially zoom. Can be a fraction
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.horizo: An integer which will offset the mini-map horizontally
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.vertic: An integer which will offset the mini-map vertically
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.active: The number of pixels to shift vertically when there's an active effect
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.coordi: When enabled, the player's current Coords will be displayed
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.biome_: When enabled, the player's current Biome will be displayed
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.coords: Sets the scale of the text rendered for Coords and Biome mini-map data
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.decora: Sets the scale of the map icons rendered in the mini-map
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.map_ma: Scale multiplier for Map Markers text on the mini-map
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.follow: Allows minimap to follow player movement instead of only displaying current map
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.rotate: When enabled the map will align itself with the player
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.cardin: Scale of cardinal directions on minimap
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.map_ch: Plays page turn sound when current active map changes. Works best when paired with no rotation and no player follow
map_atlases.configuration.minimap.automa: Automatically switches to the nearest slice when possible
map_atlases.configuration.world_map.shea: Adds a shear button to the atlas screen which allows you to cut maps
map_atlases.configuration.world_map.filt: Show filter button on atlas screen, allowing you to filter map decoration by name
map_atlases.configuration.world_map.sort: Sort bookmarks in atlas screen by distance from map center instead of just by id
map_atlases.configuration.world_map.comp: Shows a compass icon on the map screen
map_atlases.configuration.world_map.cloc: Shows a clock icon on the map screen
map_atlases.configuration.world_map.cros: Draws a crosshair at the center of the world map view
map_atlases.configuration.world_map.alte: Use bigger book like texture for worldmap view. Makes the view a bit bigger. Recommended to ebe used with map scale 1 (you might want to lower lectern one too if buttons dont show)
map_atlases.configuration.world_map.smoo: Pan smoothly. When off it will pan in map increments instead
Makes zooming work smoothly instead of in 2 maps increments
map_atlases.configuration.world_map.zoom: How fast scrolling zooms the world map in and out
map_atlases.configuration.world_map.scal: Global scale of the entire world map GUI. Keep at 1 for pixel perfect consistency
map_atlases.configuration.world_map.lect: Global scale of the entire world map GUI when opening from lectern. Keep at 1 for pixel perfect consistency
map_atlases.configuration.world_map.draw: When enabled, the Atlas world map coordinates will be displayed
map_atlases.configuration.world_map.coor: Sets the scale of the text rendered for Coords world-map data
map_atlases.configuration.world_map.deco: Sets the scale of the map icons rendered in the world-map
map_atlases.configuration.world_map.map_: Scale multiplier for Map Markers text on the world-map
map_atlases.configuration.world_map.comp: Rearranges the position of the slice indicator to be more compact. You will need supplementaries slice maps to use this
map_atlases.configuration.misc.soundScal: Multiplier for all the Atlases sound float
map_atlases.configuration.misc.in_hand_r: Render atlas like normal map when in hand
map_atlases.configuration.markers.enable: Enables custom map markers, which you can place on the map via a special pin button
map_atlases.configuration.markers.pin_tr: Allows tracking pins by pressing control, making them follow you on minimap
map_atlases.configuration.markers.mob_ra: Show nearby mobs on minimap. Also requires matching server config
map_atlases.configuration.markers.radar_: How far around the player mobs are picked up by the radar
Entities on radar will have their icon rotate
Uses yellow markers for all mobs
map_atlases.configuration.markers.night_: Recolors map texture at night to make them use night lightmap. Requires light_map config in common configs
map_atlases.configuration.markers.conver: Turn on to convert Xaeros minimap waypoints. Conversion will happen on world boot. Remember to turn back off
